description: Find and value a wallet's staked SUI with rewards, issuer-rate liquid-staking coins, CLMM/AMM liquidity, lending and balances inside owned objects. Positions include asset legs, valuation method and evidence tier; USD is null if any leg lacks a price, with unpriced_reason. Totals sum only priced positions. coverage lists unrecognised owned-object types and counts; unread lists failed reads. Lending includes protocol health ratios. leads flags near-borrow-limit positions and operated shared vaults with their holdings.

detail.description: 'summary' (default): highest-value positions fitting about 30k characters, plus all unpriced ones; omitted counts the rest. 'full': every position.
